kjv: [together with] my dead body shall they arise ... the dew of herbs
mine: their bodies shall rise ... a dew of light
note: MT nebelati "my corpse" is awkward; I read nebelotam "their corpses" (Syriac, Targum). The KJV keeps the MT but supplies "together with", turning it into the prophet rising with them. 'orot can be "herbs" (2 Kgs 4:39) or "lights"; a key OT resurrection text.
